notes: Three new minds and collab mode. Association: what goes with what (!associations idea). Feeling: how ideas feel, and to whom (!feel idea). Expectation: Lantern predicts, learns from surprise and measures its own growth (!growth, !surprises, !expect idea); what it learns fastest becomes what it wants to read. Collab mode: your phone and Prime talk, read, discuss and read again on home Wi-Fi; you can share a folder read-only. Wikipedia's front page and menu pages are no longer read.
